description: This file defines data structures, functions, and logic for parsing and loading test case files related to LLM autocompletion testing, including header parsing, content extraction, and categorization.

classes.name: ContextFile
classes.description: Represents a file with its path and content.

classes.name: CategoryTestCase
classes.description: Represents a test case with name, input, description, filename, and associated context files.

classes.name: TestCase
classes.description: Extends CategoryTestCase with an additional category field.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Represents a category containing multiple test cases.

methods.name: parseHeaders
methods.description: Parses headers from lines starting at a given index, validating required headers.

methods.name: readUntilHeaders
methods.description: Reads lines until the next header pattern or end of file, returning content and next header index.

methods.name: parseTestCaseFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a test case file, extracting description, filename, main content, and context files.

methods.name: loadTestCases
methods.description: Loads all test cases organized in category directories from the test cases directory.
